Talos Morrow Is a researcher and logotic

Base Media Lab. Morrow’s work bridges the gap

between semantic computing, post-Lacanian

psychoanalysis, and artificial intelligence, exploring the structural vulnerabilities of generative models and the development of specialized coding architectures. @ Academia.edu +2

Key Works & Research Focus

Morrow’s publications and research initiatives dive

into highly theoretical and applied programming concepts. Notable contributions include:

e Generative Monoculture: Morrow co-authored a framework investigating systemic vulnerabilities such as tail-loss and distribution narrowing that occur when generative models train on their own outputs. @ Academia.edu

e Logotic Programming: Morrow developed the formal-operational grammar and executables for

Logotic Programming, which integrates

paradoxical containment and minimal-force ethics into coding frameworks. 2
